content.short: A play-to-earn NFT game utilizing the Cardano blockchain. Step forth into the world of the interstellar Cao Wari empire!
content.description:
Phoenix Arena is a NFT play-to-earn gaming project. Character NFTs serve two functions:

NFTs have additional utility through the in-game economy and earning Phoenix arenas native Wari token. PFP NFTs can be staked. In-game item NFTs can be used to build your character, battle in the arena, rise the ranks and receive rewards depending on your position in the arena leaderboards.

Use the WARI tokens you receive to play, obtain more in-game items, character NFTs at a discounted price, and influence the future developments of the project.
